Question B-003-013-002.

Why the correct answer is right: If the repeater expects 5 kHz deviation and your transmitter only swings 2.5 kHz, the recovered audio level will be low.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Your audio will be distorted": Too much deviation or audio overdrive causes rough distorted audio; too little deviation mainly sounds quiet.
- sourceIndex 2: "Your range will be shorter": RF range is set by signal strength and path conditions; reducing deviation does not by itself reduce carrier coverage.
- sourceIndex 3: "The repeater will not respond": Access depends on signal, tone, and receiver settings; a half-deviation voice signal can still key the repeater but sound low.
